**Every player: double-click `Report.bat`** (in the mod's folder) and attach the `Shogun2-8Player-Report.txt` it puts on your Desktop. Drag the files into this box. It is one plain-text file with the MATCH CODE, other mods, the mod's event log, crash/error files and desync files.

- Mod version (v1.x):
- Game mode (co-op / head-to-head):
- Number of players, and who had the problem (host? in the battle or watching?):
- Campaign (Shogun 2 / Rise of the Samurai / Fall of the Samurai) and clans:
- Battle type (field / siege / naval / reinforcements), and who attacked (human / AI / rebels):
- When it happened (battle announced / choosing attack or spectate / loading screen / during battle / campaign map / other):
- What each player saw:
